texts.zh: 方舟舰[Root.GetName]的报告指出，船员行为出现了一些轻微异常。个人日志显示出零星的古怪之处：对个人仪容的异常关注，为接近特定同事而定期调班，以及在公共区域下班后聚会次数的增加。这些似乎都没有干扰到舰船的运作，而且船员士气异常高涨。
texts.en: Reports from Arkship [Root.GetName] have flagged several minor irregularities in crew behavior. Personal logs reveal scattered oddities: unusual attention to grooming, regular shift swaps to be around specific coworkers, and an uptick in off-duty gatherings in communal areas. None of this appears to interfere with operations, and the crew morale is unusually high.

label.zh: 注意到了。这很奇怪，但无关紧要。

texts.zh:
我们的方舟舰[Root.GetName]的舰桥和指挥人员现在进入了一种新的迷恋状态。那些奇怪而无害的行为现在已经演变成彻头彻尾的示爱活动：船员们互相给对方取精心设想的爱称，为对方制作小饰品，而且经常能看到他们[owner.species.GetHandName]牵着[owner.species.GetHandName]在走廊上散步。

工作流程已经中断，维护周期正在推迟。虽然目前还不危急，但如果这种情况持续下去，运行状态可能会受到影响。
texts.en:
Our bridge and command staff aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] have now entered a new level of infatuation. Odd if harmless behavior has now intensified into outright amorous activity: crew are exchanging elaborate epithets, crafting trinkets for one another, and can often be found strolling the corridors, [owner.species.GetHandName] in [owner.species.GetHandName].

Work routines have faltered as maintenance cycles are being deferred. While not currently critical, if this goes on, operational status could become compromised.

label.zh: 调查一下，这突然的变化来源是什么。
label.en: Investigate where the sudden change is coming from.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上最初只是有一些船员情绪激动的报告，结果局势愈演愈烈，现在成了更为严重的问题。许多船员都参与了精心策划的浪漫求爱。诗歌朗诵和公开示爱开始主导船上的日常生活。

不幸的是，并非所有的爱意都得到了回应。被拒绝导致了几次小规模冲突，至少有一名工程官选择自己宅在观测站里，宣称“除非有人真正理解他们”，否则他们不会出来。
texts.en:
Initial reports of an emotionally charged crew atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] have given way to something far more serious. Many crew members have been involved in elaborate romantic displays. Poetic recitals and public displays of affection have begun to dominate daily life on board.

Unfortunately, not all affections are reciprocated. Rejections have led to several minor altercations, and at least one engineering officer has barricaded themselves in the observatory, declaring they will not come out "until someone truly understands them".

label.en: Let love be. No need to interfere.

texts.zh:
我们乘坐方舟船[Root.GetName]时萌发了共同理想，受其启发，我们开始将爱意洒向周围的物理空间，包括方舟船本身。

储藏室比以往任何时候都更整洁，住处也比以往任何时候都更有条理。我们的领袖[arkship_leader.GetName]称这种维护为“照料我们心爱的家园”，并已很好地适应了这种相当不寻常的情况。绩效指标再次上升，居民们似乎也更快乐了。看来，当目标正确时，爱所能产生的力量远不止是风流韵事。
texts.en:
Inspired by shared ideals aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName], we have begun spreading affection to the physical space surrounding us, including the ship itself.

Storage units were cleaner and living quarters tidier than ever before. Our leader [arkship_leader.GetName] is referring to this maintenance as "tending to our beloved home", and has adapted well to this rather unusual situation. Performance metrics have risen again and the population seems happier. It appears that, when properly aimed, love can power more than amorous behavior.

texts.zh:
我们乘坐方舟船[Root.GetName]时萌发了共同理想，受其启发，我们开始将爱意洒向周围的物理空间，包括方舟船本身。

我们曾身陷绝境，直到[arkship_leader.GetName]力挽狂澜，获得了方舟的领导权。储藏室比以往任何时候都更整洁，住处也比以往任何时候都更有条理。我们的领袖[arkship_leader.GetName]称这种维护为“照料我们心爱的家园”，并已很好地适应了这种相当不寻常的情况。绩效指标再次上升，居民们似乎也更快乐了。看来，当目标正确时，爱所能产生的力量远不止是风流韵事。
texts.en:
Inspired by shared ideals aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName], we have begun spreading affection to the physical space surrounding us, including the ship itself.

We were in dire straits until [arkship_leader.GetName] took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship. Storage units were cleaner and living quarters tidier than ever before. Our leader [arkship_leader.GetName] is referring to this maintenance as "tending to our beloved home", and has adapted well to this rather unusual situation. Performance metrics have risen again and the population seems happier. It appears that, when properly aimed, love can power more than amorous behavior.

label.zh: 与爱同行，一切皆有可能！

texts.zh:
飞船[Root.GetName]上的情况已经越过了不可接受的界限。起初无伤大雅的情感宣泄，现在已经破坏了纪律、效率以及指挥结构本身。法律部门现已授权直接干预。

转变是立竿见影且彻底的。几名卷入特别具有破坏性纠葛的官员已被[arkship_leader.GetName]调离，确保恢复既定规范。曾经充满音乐和耳语情话的走廊如今只剩下回声。关于情书黑市的传言开始出现，但由于监视和恐惧，其流通量已大幅减少。士气低落，但秩序已然恢复。
texts.en:
The situation aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] has crossed an unacceptable threshold. What began as a harmless emotional flourish has since undermined discipline, efficiency, and the very structure of command. A direct intervention by law has now been authorized.

The transformation was immediate and absolute. Several officers implicated in particularly disruptive entanglements have been reassigned by [arkship_leader.GetName], ensuring a return to established norms. Corridors once lively with music and whispered declarations now echo with silence. Whispers of a black market for love letters have started, yet the flow has dwindled, choked off by surveillance and fear. Morale has dropped, but order has returned.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上发布了一个特别项目，揭示了一种不寻常的生物因子。一株神秘植物在方舟舰的过滤系统中生根发芽。我们的科学家认为，源自太空的孢子通过通风系统进入飞船，并找到了生长的场所。这种植物花朵的孢子通过我们的系统传播，导致飞船上所有人的情绪都变得异常激动。

这种植物的花朵散发出微弱的生物荧光，其根系似乎直接以飞船大气中循环的湿气为食。我们的船员形容它的气味“甜美、奇特、怀旧”。如果不加以控制，孢子将继续操控船员的情绪。然而，这种植物也表现出非凡的韧性，如果我们能正确地栽培它，甚至可能具有潜在的应用价值。
texts.en:
The special project issued aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] has revealed an unusual biological agent. A mysterious plant has taken root within the Arkship's filtration systems. Our scientists suggest that space-born spores made it on board through the ventilation systems and found a place to grow roots. The spores of the plant's flower carried through our systems are inducing heightened emotional states in all who live aboard the ship.

The plant's blossoms emit a faint bioluminescence, and its root structure appears to feed directly on the recycled humidity of the ship's atmosphere. Our crew members describe the smell as "sweet, whimsical, and nostalgic." Left unchecked, the spores will continue to manipulate the crew's emotions. The plant, however, also displays remarkable resilience, perhaps even a potential application, should we learn to cultivate it properly.

label.en: It's too dangerous. Destroy the plant.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的那株植物已被根除。它的根部已从大气管道中清除，孢子也已从飞船的空气中净化。船员们终于恢复了往常的行为。

然而，秩序的回归却留下了沉重的寂静。许多船员描述了一种隐隐作痛的缺失，仿佛有什么珍贵的东西被冲刷掉了，但我们的领袖[arkship_leader.GetName]确保了法律和秩序的恢复，尽管有不服管教的情绪。飞船可能已经可以运行，但它承载着一种无形的货物：破碎爱情的重担。
texts.en:
The plant on Arkship [Root.GetName] has been eradicated. Its roots were destroyed from the atmosphere ducts, and its spores purged from the ship's air. The crew has at last resumed their usual behavior.

However, the return to order has left a heavy silence. Many crew members describe an aching absence, as though something precious has been flushed out, but our leader [arkship_leader.GetName] ensured that law and order were restored despite the unruly feelings. The ship may be operational, but it carries an invisible cargo: the weight of broken love.

We were in dire straits until [arkship_leader.GetName] took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship. However, the return to order has left a heavy silence. Many crew members describe an aching absence, as though something precious has been flushed out, but our leader [arkship_leader.GetName] ensured that law and order were restored despite the unruly feelings. The ship may be operational, but it carries an invisible cargo: the weight of broken love.

texts.zh:
详细的基因分析已确认这种神秘植物为一个未知物种。其起源指向一个荒凉的星团。更奇怪的是，这种植物对生存条件要求极为严苛，使其在原生土壤之外的生存几乎不可能：精确的湿度水平、营养丰富的空气以及一定程度的辐射。

一项生物化学研究表明，这种植物的孢子具有作为神经调节剂的潜力。尽管存在副作用，但如果提炼得当，它们可能可以治疗焦虑、抑郁，甚至创伤。我们的领袖[arkship_leader.GetName]对这种特殊的植物产生了浓厚的兴趣，并因此决定扩展他们的农业知识。
texts.en:
Detailed genetic analysis has identified the mysterious flora as an unknown species. Its origins point to a desolate stellar cluster. Even stranger, the plant requires conditions so exacting that survival beyond its native soil should be impossible: precise levels of humidity, a nutrient rich atmosphere, and a certain degree of radiation.

A biochemical study suggests the plant's spores possess potential as a neural modulator. Despite the side effects, if properly refined, they might treat anxiety, depression, or even trauma. Our leader [arkship_leader.GetName] took a special interest in this particular plant, and has decided to expand their agricultural knowledge as a result.

texts.zh: 来自方舟舰[Root.GetName]的报告显示，船员中出现了轻微的行为异常，表现为社交活动增多以及士气高涨。这些变化的潜在原因尚不明确。
texts.en: Reports from Arkship [Root.GetName] indicate minor behavioral irregularities among the crew, marked by increased socialization and elevated morale. The underlying cause of these changes remains unclear.

texts.zh: 方舟舰[Root.GetName]的船员们长时间以来行为异常。报告显示他们的日常活动变得反复无常，其中几名船员表现出对某种事物迷恋，并且什么事情都藏着掖着的迹象。建议进行调查。
texts.en: The crew members of Arkship [Root.GetName] have been acting abnormally for an extended period. Reports suggest their routines have become erratic, with several crew members displaying signs of infatuation and secrecy. Investigation is recommended.
